ns2:course.label: Plant Breeding Methods
ns2:course.description: Discussion of the application of current scientific tools and methods available to plant breeders for improving plants; emphasis on actual use of plant breeding methods and production of high quality seed. Offered summer only in alternate years. Prerequisite: CPSC 453.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Offered summer only in alternate years. Prerequisite: CPSC 453.
